authorization: Plan and implement GTEx organ-expert training, mechanical smoke tests, full training, staged ARCHS4 testing, and prospective ARCHS4 fine-tuning experiments.

relationship_to_prior_result.completed_direction: ARCHS4-trained frozen K4 evaluated once on GTEx V11
relationship_to_prior_result.preservation_rule: The completed result remains unchanged. GTEx becomes development data only for candidates trained under this new protocol.

primary_question: Can donor-controlled organ supervision learned from GTEx improve masked reconstruction on heterogeneous, study-disjoint ARCHS4 human bulk RNA-seq?

organ_selection.change_allowed_before_freeze: only a reproducible metadata, anatomy-review, overlap, or feasibility gate failure
organ_selection.change_forbidden_after_freeze: any expression value, loss, prediction, effect, or model comparison

preliminary_inventory.caution: ARCHS4 counts are automated metadata candidates and require manual review before lockbox freeze.

gtex_development.allowed_description: nominally non-diseased adult human postmortem or organ-donor tissue
gtex_development.split_unit: global donor across every organ and tissue site
gtex_development.split_algorithm: SHA256 rank of split seed NUL donor ID
gtex_development.random_partition_rule: donor-atomic deterministic greedy balancing of organ sample vectors across K shards

strict_model_family.name: gtex_only_k8
strict_model_family.pooled_trunk: ExpressionPerformer trained from random initialization on GTEx train donors
strict_model_family.experts: eight residual adapters trained on the frozen GTEx-only pooled trunk
strict_model_family.random_controls: three matched donor-atomic random K8 adapter banks
strict_model_family.router: target-hidden blind eight-class GTEx organ router
strict_model_family.normalization: TPM then exactly one log1p transform

transfer_sensitivity.name: archs4_pretrained_gtex_adapted
transfer_sensitivity.claim_limit: not a strict GTEx-to-ARCHS4 reversal because the trunk contains ARCHS4 pretraining

archs4_stages: spaceflight or space-analog versus matched ground or terrestrial control
nested ARCHS4 development-only fine-tuning exposure doses
remaining_before_protocol_freeze: commit a reproducible GTEx/ARCHS4 organ-inventory report
freeze the expanded GTEx exact-header cohort and source hashes
freeze pooled architecture and update-budget selection limits
freeze target-hidden gene panel handling for the expanded cohort
freeze the ARCHS4 metadata-review and staged lockbox construction protocol
